# Pro Photo GR

> Pro Photo GR is the studio of Ioannis Mastrostamatis (Ιωάννης Μαστροσταμάτης), a professional photographer based in Athens, Greece. The studio offers portrait, product, event, couple, and automotive photography plus videography for brands, e-shops, and individuals.

## About
- Practitioner: Ioannis Mastrostamatis (Ιωάννης Μαστροσταμάτης)
- Studio: Pro Photo GR
- Location: Athens, Greece
- Experience: 5+ years
- Languages: Greek, English

## Services
- Portrait photography (artistic, studio, lifestyle)
- Product / e-commerce photography (white background, lifestyle, catalogue)
- Event photography (private and corporate)
- Couple photography
- Automotive photography
- Videography and short-form video for social media
- Studio setup and lighting
- Image post-production
